blocks.text: 605 150 E Cordova Street Downtown VE Vancouver V6A 0E7

parts.t: Attention investors and first-time home seekers! Embrace the charm of this 1-bedroom unit at InGastown, centrally located and efficiently designed. The space features contemporary kitchen appliances, loft-style concrete floors, and a stylish bathroom. Positioned in the heart of Gastown, enjoy access to trendy restaurants, boutique shopping, and vibrant nightlife. Additional perks include a bike room, storage, and a rooftop patio with stunning views and BBQ facilities. Currently rented at $2400/month, this unit promises positive cash flow for investors or serves as an ideal first home for a young couple. Don't miss the chance to be part of Vancouver's exciting and evolving neighborhood, just steps away from the pulse of transformation!
